newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE SIGNS UP ITALIANS TO INSPECT PUBLIC WORKS.
newsitem.headline: GREECE SIGNS UP ITALIANS TO INSPECT PUBLIC WORKS.

text.p: Greece's national economy ministry has appointed Italian consulting firm Ismes SpA as its quality inspector for public works with a total budget in excess of 7.0 trillion drachmas ($24.9 billion), co-funded by the European Union -- it said in a statement.

The inspector will carry out quality checks on some 1,500-2,000 projects over the next two years, corresponding to 10 percent of total public works in progress, it said. ($1 = 281.5 drachmas) --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
